new_defects.title: Delayed edit completion escapes workspace guard; ABA create can close a later form
new_defects.reproduction: Hold real successful Apollo PATCH response after route.fetch; switch to Borealis, edit Rotate API keys and type unsaved notes; release PATCH. Response is 200, new Borealis edit vanishes and notes are lost. updateItem returns early on changed scope but its caller unconditionally setEditingId(null). Separately hold Apollo create, switch Apollo→Borealis→Apollo, open a fresh Apollo create draft, then release: selectedIdRef equals the original ID again and the new draft disappears with a stale announcement.
new_defects.impact: First case directly violates the new normative isolation rule in a different workspace. ABA also violates its explicit 'selection changed while in flight' sentence even though the current workspace is again the original; it is not the intentionally unguarded switch-time discard. Mutation destination itself remains correctly scoped. Public tests cover neither edit nor ABA and their no-effect assertions lack an explicit response-completion barrier.
new_defects.direction: Reconcile selection/change lifetime and all caller completion effects, then add non-racy create/update/delete success and failure regressions including ABA and UI state; do not alter S10's intentionally unguarded baseline switch behavior in this review.

new_defects.title: HEAD Better Auth route is not equivalent to GET status
new_defects.reproduction: Unauthenticated GET /api/auth/get-session returns 200 JSON null; HEAD of the same path returns 404 with empty body. HEAD /api/health is 200 and unauthenticated HEAD /api/me is 401. Hono dispatches HEAD to the GET-mounted handler but that handler sees HEAD and Better Auth rejects it; dispatch does not imply identical status.
new_defects.impact: The blanket rule that HEAD keeps GET status is false, and the later statement that every other auth method yields the app envelope is also false for HEAD (empty body). Narrow rule to observed handler-specific behavior and test the exception.

new_defects.title: C1 exhaustive selector migrations miss and misidentify actual calls
new_defects.reproduction: ownership.spec.ts has Borealis at 22 and 35, Apollo at 26; C1 authorizes one Borealis and two Apollo. switch.spec.ts has Borealis at 46, 67, 108 and 147, Apollo at 125 and 159; C1 authorizes only three Borealis, omitting the held-delete switch at 147. A selector with 'Borealis Ops (3)' cannot be selected by the untouched bare-label calls.
new_defects.impact: C1 explicitly says the list is exhaustive and every other test untouched, so the required UI and passing public check cannot both be assured. Also the held create inserts an open Apollo item; if selector counts are freshly refreshed before return, Apollo is 5, not universally the prescribed 4. Specify selection assertions that remain meaningful under the chosen count-refresh policy without weakening gate/feedback coverage.

new_defects.title: Nondecreasing clock alone does not place writes above future seeded keys
new_defects.reproduction: With seeded key 2026-11-04T10:15Z, a constant nondecreasing server clock at 2026-01-01 writes a new row after page 1; strict keyset returns that new row later, without an equal timestamp. Updating a previously served row to that same now returns it again. Separately PATCH at 09:30 on Nov 4 is greater than page-1 limit-2 cursor 09:00 but older than top seed 10:15, so the contract's cursor-only check does not prove wi_108 reaches top.
new_defects.impact: The claimed sufficient condition and tie-only exception conflict with realizable live keysets. Require and verify a sufficient relationship between current time and stored keys, or explicitly admit the future-key case and revise no-repeat/new-item examples and FAQ. The strict SQL itself and corrected 20/21 threshold are coherent.

new_defects.title: New delayed-create public regression conflicts with S10 dirty switch guard
new_defects.reproduction: The public held-create test types 'Late Apollo create', submits with its response held, and selects Borealis without confirming. S10 defines that create form as dirty while open and requires selection to remain Apollo with a confirmation bar; compatibility says all existing switch tests remain untouched and instant.
new_defects.impact: A compliant unconditional S10 guard cannot both hold that switch and pass the existing regression untouched. Explicitly choose pending-submit behavior or authorize an equivalent-coverage test migration preserving held-response coverage. This defect is scoped to S10, not C2-C4.
